accreditation_status: Contracted by ENX Association; only audit providers contracted by ENX Association may conduct TISAX assessments; they may only assess registered TISAX participants and only where they have had no previous consulting assignment with that participant (impartiality / no conflict of interest)
geographic_coverage: Worldwide; all TISAX audit providers can generally conduct TISAX assessments worldwide; local sales staff and auditors per country are listed at enx.com/en-US/TISAX/xap/
industry_specialization: Automotive supply chain (TISAX / ISA criteria catalogues: Information Security, Prototype Protection, Data Protection)
average_audit_duration_days: Rough guidance only: three and a half to four man-days for an assessment in AL 2 and five to six man-days for an assessment in AL 3, for an average small company with one location
contact_person: Audit provider contact details are provided in the registration confirmation email, not on the public website
